summaryZh: Zarrinpar Lab 研究肠道微生物、昼夜节律与肠道生理的交互作用，关注其失调如何影响代谢和炎症疾病。实验室利用工程化本土细菌操纵肠道微生物功能，开展宿主与微生物关系的机制研究。
researchQuestions: 肠道微生物组与肠上皮细胞、肝细胞昼夜节律的相互作用发生失调时，如何促成代谢性和炎症性疾病？

evidence.quote: At the Zarrinpar Lab, we are pioneering the study of the gut microbiome and its impact on human health.
The main area of our investigation is the relationship between the gut microbiome and the circadian rhythms of enterocytes and hepatic cells.

To test these hypotheses, the lab has pioneered a new technique to functionally manipulate the gut microbiome using engineered native bacteria. This allows for in-depth, mechanistic studies of host-microbe relationships.

The main area of our investigation is the relationship between the gut microbiome and the circadian rhythms of enterocytes and hepatic cells. We are particularly interested in understanding how dysfunctions at this interface contribute to metabolic and inflammatory disorders.
